correctness.rationale: Conditional on the cited Zhang--Jin hemisphere criterion, the transport geometry is correct. For a fixed closed hemisphere H, every coupling to a measure supported in H costs at least the point-to-H distance and a measurable nearest-point projection attains equality; minimizing over hemisphere directions gives distance to the union. The concavity of Delta_p to the power p is the infimum of linear functionals, closedness gives the 1-Lipschitz distance-to-bad-set property, and x<=arcsin x<=(pi/2)x yields the moment-body comparison. An independent three-point circle calculation agrees with the fixed-hemisphere L2 formula. The primary preprint full text could not be retrieved; only its abstract confirming a necessary-and-sufficient criterion was accessible, so the exact attribution of the hemisphere wording remains an access risk rather than contrary evidence.
